products.desc_de: Aus hochwertigem PTFE mit Edelstahlgeflecht gefertigt. Ideal für Motorsport und Aerospace. Verfügbar in S700FC, S701, S710, S740 und S750 — AN3 bis AN16.

products.desc_en: Perfect for quick connections and disconnections between flexible hoses and rigid tubing using Adel Wiggins/Hydraflow connectors. Best used with S7 PG fittings.

products.desc_en: High-performance PTFE hose. MWP up to 88 bar. Available in -04 to -24 dash sizes. For fuel, oil and pneumatics.

products.desc_en: Durable, lightweight precision-machined aluminum fittings. Crimp/swage type. Compatible hose: 910/811. For fuel, oil, water, methanol and pneumatics.

products.desc_de: S4 FL-Verschraubungen für schnelle Verbindungen zwischen flexiblen Schläuchen und Starrrohren mit Adel Wiggins/Hydraflow Steckern.
products.desc_en: S4 FL fittings for quick connections between flexible hoses and rigid tubing using Adel Wiggins/Hydraflow connectors. Best used with S4 PG fittings.

products.desc_en: AN fittings in 811 and 812 series with multiple angle configurations: 0°, 45°, 90°, 120°, 150°, 180°.

products.desc_en: High-quality quick-release couplings for hard tube to flexible hose (0.5" to 4" dia). Aerospace, motorsport, marine. Single-handed operation, locking latch, no safety wire needed.

products.name_en: Pro:Spec No Nut Quick Release System

products.desc_en: High-quality anodized aluminum. CPL series (45°, 90°, 120°, 150°, 180° female couplers). Reliable performance in demanding environments.

products.desc_en: AN816 (0° male JIC to NPT) and AN823 (45° male JIC to NPT) adaptors. Full size range for connecting hydraulic fittings to NPT ports.
